entities.summary: Andrei Nikolaevich Lankov is a Russo-Australian scholar of Asia and specialist in Korean studies and Director of Korea Risk Group, the parent company of NK News and NK Pro. In the 1990s, he worked in South Korea and Australia, and has been teaching in Seoul since 2004.
